propositions: When a gate encounters an LLMUnavailableError on the infra-exception path, an additive gate_error_v1 sidecar record with verdict=ERROR and non-empty error.cause must be written before the gate returns its pre-existing outcome (INDETERMINATE for plan/code-review, exception propagation for completion).

The plan-review and code-review gates must preserve their soft-degrade contract (returning INDETERMINATE) after emitting the ERROR record; the completion gate must preserve its fail-close contract (re-raising after emitting the ERROR record).
The gate_error_v1 schema must not route through reconcile_verdict so that the ERROR verdict survives and is not coerced to FAIL.
Domain BLOCK/FAIL verdicts (non-infra exceptions) must not emit a gate_error_v1 record.
Existing verdict readers (latest_review_result, latest_fail_verdict) must remain schema-guarded and skip gate_error_v1 records so ERROR verdicts do not pollute existing verdict reads.
